name: Spotify
description: Search tracks, read playback state, control playback, and use Web Playback in the browser (Premium + OAuth).
author: ChatBridge

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Search Spotify catalog for tracks. Returns names, artists, and spotify URIs for playback.

tools.name: get_currently_playing
tools.description: Get the user's currently playing track on Spotify, if any.

tools.name: get_playback_state
tools.description: Get full Spotify player state (device, shuffle, progress, etc.).

tools.name: start_resume_playback
tools.description: Start or resume playback. Pass uri (spotify:track:...) or uris array. Empty body resumes current context (requires active device).

uris.description: JSON array of track URIs (optional; use uri for one track)

tools.name: transfer_to_web_player
tools.description: Transfer Spotify playback to this browser's Web Playback device so audio plays in the chat iframe.
